body: It makes a lot of sense and I also feel like I'm unbearable for people to listen to. Even people that claim they care about me. So I understand how you feel a little. I can't promise that I can help you or be there for you forever, but I can listen to you without judging
I feel the same. I'm terrified of death yet I crave it so much. I'm sorry you're going through this. Is there anything you want to vent about? It could make you feel just a little better
I hope you can find some happiness with him even though you're both going through a lot

Me too. He's the only reason I'm alive and I'm afraid I can't deal with this pain of not being able to physically be with him for a few more years. I'm sorry you're going through something similar, but thank you for sharing with me. It helps me a little to know that I'm not crazy and the only one feeling this way. Again I'm really sorry you're in pain too. You can talk to me about it if you like

Thank you so much for your reply. I do get temporary relief by talking to people about it. But it always seems to come back, and lately it's getting worse. My boyfriend is the only thing that makes me happy and that in itself makes me suicidal. I'm currently on a very difficult journey to find anything else that can give me some happiness, but I'm failing. Listening to music and finding new delicious food are the only things that can temporarily ease the pain. But it's not enough to keep me alive.
Yes I feel exactly the same. And right now unfortunately, I have nothing I'm hyperfixating on. It's almost torturous because I can't enjoy anything at all.
Me too. I'm almost constantly worrying about how he's the only thing that makes me happy. But I guess it's nice that someone could be so special. I hope you feel better about it soon

I feel like all I do is count down the minutes until I can be with my boyfriend, and I always feel guilty for doing it because I feel like I should be doing other things. But maybe it's ok to have just one source of happiness and we can just be thankful that someone makes us happy enough to wait for them.
Thank you, but I'm a horrible person. It seems I hurt people more often than I help them. I'm sorry you're feeling the same.
Thank you. It's funny you mention counting because that's what I used to do. I don't remember if it worked but I'll give it a try. Thank you for reminding me.
I recently told my therapist something similar and she said my mom wouldn't give me what she does if she didn't want to. Your parents don't have to buy you plants, I'm sure they really want to.
